body:
## Parent

[Implementation specification #12](https://github.com/stepanosokin/hmc-app-prototype/issues/12). Approved slice T15; coverage: **M4; A3, A8**.

Follow bilingual specification v0.3 and parent #12's numeric browser tile/GPU amendment, preserving M1-M5 and A1-A12. Numeric display tiles are in scope; bulk analytical coverage downloads remain deferred. Planning acceptance is not successful implementation evidence. Record failed compatibility gates and revisit the affected decision; do not silently replace the accepted architecture.

## What to build

New publications notify visitors without changing their pinned view, and responsive controls preserve context on small screens.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Notify about new runs and revisions; switching runs or refreshing availability within the same run is explicit.
- [x] Keep the current published selection usable during update failures and while new data arrive; no silent run/revision switching occurs.
- [x] Implement full-screen map, compact controls, bottom time bar, stable legend and point card, with a collapsible small-screen control sheet preserving run/time context.
- [x] Exercise publication during browser navigation, acceptance/declining of updates, stale responses, failures and small-screen interactions against Compose.
- [x] Attach browser/API/GIS consistency and Russian/UTC behavior evidence for A3/A8; do not add native mobile, fabricated observations or wind animation.

- [x] Verify explicit revision refresh switches numeric tile metadata/texture identities together with point selection; failed/unaccepted updates preserve the pinned view. Test responsive GPU rendering and bounded resource replacement on declared desktop/mobile browsers without introducing temporal blending or wind particles.

## Visual concept amendment — v0.5 (accepted 2026-10-20)

Follow specification section 9.1 and the [confirmed concept](https://github.com/stepanosokin/hmc-app-prototype/blob/main/docs/prototypes/design-concept.ru.md). [T22 / #34](https://github.com/stepanosokin/hmc-app-prototype/issues/34) supplies the visually approved desktop/phone mockup before responsive viewer implementation; its demonstration evidence does not replace this ticket's real Compose and update-race checks.

- [x] Implement one phone bottom sheet, initially collapsed: a map tap opens point details to half the screen, and settings use the same sheet. Keep the time bar and selected time accessible and preserve run/time context, with Russian controls and UTC timestamps.
- [x] Compare real desktop/phone layouts and visible interactions with the approved T22 mockup, including point/settings sheet transitions, time navigation while the sheet is open, explicit updates and failure states; retain this ticket's existing numerical/GPU and stale-response checks.

## Testing

Run relevant checks in local Docker Compose with pinned containers, isolated test volumes and explicit test/demo clocks. Exercise observable behavior through the gateway with real services for publication, GeoServer and access-policy gates; focused decoder/storage checks run in pinned containers. Test behavior rather than private implementation details. Synthetic fixtures are explicit supplements to actual-sample validation. Desktop QGIS checks and agreed-host operational measurements are required where stated; local success alone does not establish compatibility or capacity.

## Scope boundary

Deliver this approved slice only. Martin/vector layers, future production modules, native mobile, numerical raster downloads, payments and tariffs remain deferred. The M1 numerical-adapter comparison and selection must precede M3 finalization. Leave the content and status of parent #12 and the completed wayfinder map unchanged.

## Web-map projection amendment — v0.6 (accepted 2026-10-20)

Follow specification section 9.2 and [ADR 0003](https://github.com/stepanosokin/hmc-app-prototype/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-web-map-display-projections.md). These new requirements are unverified and do not change historical completed scope or milestones.

- [x] Implement accessible desktop/phone projection controls following T24 / #36 and specification 9.2. Preserve run/revision/time/units/geographic point on switching, and centre/comparable extent where feasible. Hide markers behind the globe or outside LAEA with a Russian explanation while retaining the point selection; background/out-of-domain clicks do not choose a point.
- [x] Exercise projection switching during tile fetch/decode/upload, point requests, publication updates and GPU failures against real Compose services. Reject stale work from the previous mode; retain existing run/time invalidation and explicit-revision rules. Demonstrate Mercator startup, current-mode coverage fit and explicit unsupported-mode recovery at desktop/minimum phone sizes.

## Implementation evidence — T15

Все 10 критериев проверены на реальном Compose: полные Chrome/Edge и физический Samsung SM-S936B (Android 17 / Chrome 155). Явное принятие редакции сохраняет срок; поле, метаданные и точка меняются атомарно. Отказы API/GPU и устаревшие ответы сохраняют закреплённый выбор. Одна мобильная панель и доступная шкала времени сверены с T22/T24.

[Приёмка, числовые результаты, review и очистка](https://github.com/stepanosokin/hmc-app-prototype/blob/main/docs/evidence/t15/validation.md). Обновлённое поле: ошибка <0,0018 K, маски совпали, point/EDR/WMS согласованы; не более двух array-текстур. Safari/iOS сохраняет ранее согласованную отсрочку T23; родитель #12 и milestones не изменены.
